product.name: LLM
promise: Credentials, routes and costs stay explicit.
product.lede: llm is a set of Rust libraries for calling language models through one neutral interface. A caller runs a turn; behind it, an operator chooses the wire protocol, the account, the credential source, the route and its fallbacks, and llm keeps each of those choices separate and visible. It never runs a tool, never runs a login flow, and never turns an unknown usage count into a zero.
product.meta: Rust libraries · Responses, Messages and Chat Completions · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

sections.title: Refuse the guess, keep the evidence.
sections.lede: Model clients tend to fail quietly: they guess where they should have refused. llm is built around refusing those guesses and recording what actually happened.

items.title: One port for every wire
items.description: Model::turn is the same for a Responses, Messages or Chat Completions endpoint, an anonymous local vLLM server or a subscription login. A caller depends on the port, not on a vendor SDK.

items.title: Credentials injected, never searched for
items.description: A catalog names an opaque reference; the embedding supplies the resolver. Files, keychains, environment variables, JSON pointers, a Codex login and the Secrets library are opt-in adapters.

items.title: Routes you can explain
items.description: Strict TOML catalogs, an explanation that resolves no secret, same-target retry before any output is visible, then ordered fallback across named alternatives only.

items.title: Qualified against live providers
items.description: The gate runs against recorded bytes, loopback sockets and in-process fakes. API and subscription access is not yet qualified for any provider.

sections.title: From a caller's turn to a priced observation.
sections.lede: Each step is its own crate, and each refuses on its own before the next one runs.

steps.label: llm-core
steps.title: Validate the turn
steps.description: Against the target's declared capabilities, before any network I/O.

steps.label: llm-routing
steps.title: Select and explain
steps.description: The route's first compatible target; retry it, then fall back in declared order.

steps.label: llm-credentials
steps.title: Resolve the credential
steps.description: At request time, through the resolver the embedding injected.

steps.label: protocol client
steps.title: One attempt
steps.description: Over the bounded transport, events streamed to the caller as they arrive.

steps.label: llm-cost
steps.title: Price what was observed
steps.description: Exact decimals; unknown counts stay unknown, and a ledger admits or refuses spend.
